notes.title: Christmas Giveaway - Get GNOMED!
notes.content:
[h1]Merry Christmas🎅🎄 everyone! Time for some free keys!🔑[/h1]

Make sure to [b]download the DEMO and join our Discord[/b] in order to participate in the giveaway and find more info and rules about the event![/h2]
